title: March 2026: Video generation, grade level, voice customization, and more.
summary: Check out our March 2026 updates, including video generation, customizable AI voices, grade-level support, timed student responses, AI image watermarks, and upgraded image generation.
body_markdown: One of our most-requested features is here! You can now customize Sparky's voice to better fit your classroom. Choose from a range of voices, including more feminine or masculine options, and adjust the tone to fit your world language practice, role-playing activities, and more.[Learn more about customizing Sparky's voice.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/13827041-how-to-customize-sparky-s-voice)
